scope: OGE task 10 probability prototypes; structures, not numeric clones
source_policy: A structure is confirmed only when a task ID supports the construction itself.

enabled.structure: Choose one object uniformly; ask for one explicitly named category.
enabled.generator: Build disjoint category counts summing to the population; query one category.
enabled.ranges: source examples are 12 objects and 20 objects; generated count ranges 12..100
enabled.complexity: one favorable count divided by total; exact single numeric answer
enabled.answer_format: terminating decimal in [0,1], at most 3 decimal places
enabled.weight_status: preliminary; equal family rotation is a coverage safeguard, not an exam-frequency estimate

enabled.structure: Uniform single selection; target event is the complement of a described subset.
enabled.generator: Subtract the count of the excluded property from the population, then divide by total.
enabled.complexity: one complement subtraction followed by a probability ratio
enabled.answer_format: terminating decimal in [0,1], at most 3 decimal places

enabled.structure: Estimate a single selection probability from observed counts in a finite batch.
enabled.generator: Use favorable items / inspected items, with the complement count stated in the condition.
enabled.ranges: source populations 50 and 80; generated populations 20..200 from fixed plausible totals
enabled.complexity: one complement count and an exact relative frequency
enabled.answer_format: terminating decimal in [0,1], at most 3 decimal places
enabled.weight_status: preliminary; only two concrete examples inspected

enabled.structure: Known categories leave an even residual split equally into two disjoint classes; ask for a known class or one residual class.
enabled.generator: Subtract known counts, halve the residual, add the requested disjoint favorable counts, divide by total.
enabled.complexity: three visible counts, exact residual parity condition, one addition and a ratio
enabled.answer_format: terminating decimal in [0,1], at most 3 decimal places

enabled.structure: Uniform selection among a partition; find the probability of the third category described as the remainder.
enabled.generator: Subtract two known disjoint category counts from the total.
enabled.complexity: two subtractions followed by a ratio
enabled.answer_format: terminating decimal in [0,1], at most 3 decimal places

enabled.structure: Two attributes overlap; counts are given for only-first, only-second, and both; ask for one attribute.
enabled.generator: Add the only-second and intersection counts, then divide by total.
enabled.complexity: one addition that must include the intersection exactly once
enabled.answer_format: terminating decimal in [0,1], at most 3 decimal places
